comment: Variation of chameleon-first-long-worm: a human Priest creates five peaceful chameleons, so a different role, inventory and chameleon count reach mon.c newcham()'s worm.c get_wormno()/initworm() call on a level that has never held a worm. Seed 830027 came from a port-only scan of seeds 830001-830060 with this input, which found 4 seeds whose 6bd668f8 replay stopped on that slot allocation; here the first long worm appears on turn 17.
